text:
Samira Khan: Hey team, quick first-day question — my home office Wi-Fi uses a certificate-based Aruba setup. Do I need to register anything for the corporate VPN, or is Okta SSO + the Redwood VPN client enough? Also I saw an email about Security Basics training — what's the deadline? :wave:

Alexa Rivera: Congrats and welcome Samira! For VPN you just use Okta SSO + the corp VPN client, no need to register your home AP. Training is required within 14 days of start — link is in #onboarding-materials. I’ll DM you the checklist. :white_check_mark:

Josef Mfcller: Quick clarifying points: connecting a company-issued laptop to your home network is fine, but you must enroll the laptop in MDM and enable full-disk encryption (FileVault for macOS). If you want a walkthrough I can jump on a quick call. The Security Basics class is recorded and completion is tracked centrally.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: Security Basics course assigned to @Samira Khan, due 14 days from start date (1912348901). Course link: https://learn.redwood/sec-basics — please mark complete after finishing.

Samira Khan: Thanks! One more thing — am I allowed to do day-to-day development on my personal MacBook? I run local containers and have some personal secrets stored in Keychain, so I'm a bit worried about policy/data leakage.

Josef Mfcller: Short answer: personal devices are allowed only with an approved exception. Requirements for exceptions: enroll device in MDM, enable disk encryption, install the company-approved browser profile and enable OS-level screen lock. For most new hires we recommend using the company laptop or a loaner. Contractors have stricter rules. Open a "personal device exception" ticket with People Ops if you need it.

Lydia Chen: If you prefer a company machine, I can expedite a loaner — ETA 2-3 business days for standard macbook. For setup we usually run the management profile; example command (mac):
```
sudo profiles install -type configuration -path ~/redwood/management.mobileconfig
```
That applies MDM and the certs. Ping me and I’ll open the provisioning ticket.

Samira Khan: Perfect, I'll take a company laptop. Can someone add me to the security channel and the training roster? My manager said they'd handle it but want to be safe.

Alexa Rivera: Done — you’re added to #sec-updates and #new-joiners. I also cc'd you on the training ticket and sent the loaner request to IT.

Josef Mfcller: We do a quick 15adminute security checklist walk-through for new hires tomorrow at 11:00 AM PST. @Samira Khan can you make that? If not we have a 3:00 PM slot as backup.

Samira Khan: 11:00 AM works for me, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
